scope: All 104 original numbered checks read and classified. Status assesses recovered evidence, not innocence/guilt or completion of the whole compliance test. No item is labelled verified compliance. T4 concerns research provenance only. I103 concerns the present journalistic task, not immunity from bidder remedies.

status_legend.T: Tested with primary evidence (bounded test only)

rows.title: Identify the transaction precisely
rows.assessment: Original award identifies contractor and instrument; signed lot/SA crosswalk is missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Test: Match legal supplier, solicitation, contract, lot and supply arrangement; do not merge different suppliers' awards or RFP-A and RFP-B. [S01, S02]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Executed CW2467949, award recommendation, procurement index, legal name/business number, all associated instrument IDs and versions.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Related notices use a common solicitation number but govern separate lots; the contract crosswalk explains the apparent mismatch.

rows.title: Recover the controlling document hierarchy
rows.assessment: No signed order of precedence or complete incorporated annex set.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Read the signed instrument's order-of-precedence clause and every incorporated annex, standard clause, certification and amendment, with effective version dates.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Complete signature package, statement of work, specifications, basis of payment, delivery schedule, security checklist, bid incorporated by reference and acceptance terms.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A provision that looks inconsistent in a public summary is correctly defined in a higher-ranking annex or authorized amendment.

rows.title: Build a timestamped chronology
rows.assessment: Event and posting chronology exists; signature, receipt, qualification and FOCI timestamps do not.
rows.original_test: P1 | Fact check: Distinguish drafting, approval, signature, effective date, notification, public announcement, option exercise and payment.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Native timestamps and time zones for RFSA submission, qualification, invitations, bid receipt, evaluations, security approval, award and notice publication.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A date discrepancy reflects posting or notification after the legal event. A same-day announcement does not establish which event happened first.

rows.title: Preserve originals and provenance
rows.status_label: Tested with primary evidence (bounded test only)
rows.assessment: Native sources, labelled extractions, hashes and inherited-source limits tested; controlling packages still unavailable.
rows.original_test: P1 | Evidence quality: Separate original government records, issuer filings, third-party mirrors and interview recollections. Never silently substitute a current RFSA round for the August version.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Native downloads, URLs, retrieval dates, hashes, attachments, revision history and provenance log; independent corroboration for mirror-only amendment counts.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A search snippet or aggregator is stale, incomplete or combines versions; the authenticated source removes the inconsistency.

rows.title: Establish what a system contains
rows.assessment: Issuer describes a system package, but contractual unit and line-item schedule remain missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Confirm the unit of measure before calculating quantities or prices. “System,” “kit,” “aircraft” and “ground station” are not interchangeable. [S03]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Line-item schedule showing airframes, controllers, payloads, radios, batteries, spares, software, freight, training and documentation; shared versus per-kit equipment.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: One package contains common support equipment or multiple airframes. Dividing C$439,851.55 by 100 would then misstate aircraft price.

rows.title: Identify the Crown contracting authority
rows.assessment: Primary DPWGS powers/delegation provisions and DIA structure checked; actual signatory/delegation missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law and delegation: Identify who could contract and who actually signed. CAF, DND, PSPC and DIA are not interchangeable legal authorities. [S07, S08]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Signature block, statutory authority relied on, departmental mandate, procurement-service agreement and dated delegation to the individual signatory.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: PSPC or an authorized successor unit acted for DND under a valid delegation rather than DND's ordinary internal limit.

rows.title: Test the correct competition route
rows.assessment: Selective SA competition is described; actual SA rules and NSE applicability unresolved.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law and contract: The public record describes selective competition under an SA, not a sole-source purchase. Test that route before looking for sole-source justification. GCR sections 3, 5, 6 and 7 must be read together. [S01, S09]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Approved procurement strategy, SA ordering rules, invitation records and any exception actually used.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Competition among the properly selected qualified suppliers satisfied the applicable route even if only one responsive offer remained.

rows.title: Verify any national security exception
rows.assessment: NSE law and dated-policy conflict checked; no actual scoped approval instrument.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law and policy: A no-agreements field does not itself establish an NSE. Obtain the signed responsible-ADM-or-equivalent approval letter dated before the award day, with scope covering this purchase, and the required rationale/strategy record. [S10, S11]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Approval or non-sensitive reference identifying authority/date, program coverage, rationale and secured record location.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A valid program-level letter covered this procurement; classified details are properly held separately.

rows.title: Apply the post 2024 GCR rule
rows.assessment: December 2024 exclusion and surviving s.18 verified; application depends on actual NSE.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law: Since 16 December 2024, GCR 3(1)(i) excludes qualifying NSE contracts from the regulations, while 3(3) preserves section 18. Do not apply a pre-2024 argument requiring an additional section 6 exception automatically. [S09]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Relevant NSE instrument, legal applicability determination and surviving terms.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The procurement was properly excluded from bid-solicitation provisions, while remaining subject to other applicable financial, policy and contractual controls.

rows.title: Test CFTA coverage separately
rows.assessment: August 2026 CFTA original reviewed; award-specific coverage rationale is missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Treaty: Apply the August 2026 CFTA text, its entity, goods, value and exception provisions. Canada's Annex 519.1 lists no excluded entities or exceptions/notes; international defence-goods exclusions cannot simply be imported. National security is Article 901 in this version. [S12]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Written CFTA analysis and precise alternative exclusion or NSE relied on.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A valid Article 901 invocation or another actually applicable provision explains non-coverage; the notice alone does not.

rows.title: Test international agreements separately
rows.assessment: International defence schedules and actual classification not independently completed; no coverage finding.
rows.original_test: P1 | Treaty: CETA, CPTPP and revised WTO-GPA have entity schedules, defence-goods lists and other exclusions. Identify the real commodity and end user rather than inferring coverage from PSPC administration or one radio component. [S13-S15]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Agreement-by-agreement analysis, FSC classification, goods/services allocation and applicable schedule versions.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The purchase falls outside a defence positive list or within a valid exception even though its value exceeds the threshold.

rows.title: Calculate the correct procurement value
rows.assessment: Public initial amount and issuer options differ; regime-specific pre-solicitation valuation absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Treaty and policy: Use each regime's valuation rule, including relevant options and duration; do not substitute the first invoice or public initial value. For 2026-27, federal CFTA goods threshold is C$34,700; CETA/GPA/CPTPP goods/services threshold is C$239,200. [S12-S16]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Pre-solicitation estimate, option assumptions, taxes treatment and valuation date.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A defensible exclusion applies despite the numerical threshold; different approval and reporting values legitimately use different rules.

rows.title: Check contract approval and signing limits
rows.assessment: Official 2026 Appendix A basic table now acquired by PDF extraction; actual signatory, exceptional/instrument limits and estimate remain unresolved.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy and delegation: Separate project approval, expenditure initiation, contract approval and signature authority. Apply the limits effective on the approval date, including the changes effective 15 December 2025. [S08, S17]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Delegation chart, full approval valuation, risk/complexity assessment, special authority and Treasury Board decision if required.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A valid higher-level or exceptional approval covers the option-inclusive amount. An old public limit is not the controlling ceiling.

rows.title: Check commitment and payment controls
rows.assessment: FAA ss.32-34/40 read from primary pre-award consolidation; actual commitments and certifications missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law: FAA sections 32, 33 and 34 address different financial controls. Establish sufficient authority for amounts falling due in the fiscal year; do not assume all five-year options needed immediate appropriation. [S07]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Commitment record, financial coding, authorized approvals, appropriation/availability clause and separation of certification/payment duties.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Where consistent with fiscal-year obligations and applicable commitment rules, only the firm obligation was committed initially; later options required fresh funding and authorization.

rows.title: Check procurement division and bundling
rows.assessment: Nine related records reconciled without missing-money inference; original packaging rationale absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Treaty and policy: Test whether lots, prototypes, support contracts or staged awards were structured to evade an applicable threshold or approval rule; identify that rule first. [S12-S16]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Original needs forecast, acquisition plan, related awards, combined estimates and documented reasons for packaging.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Multiple awards, competitive experimentation, operational sequencing or genuinely separate requirements explain the structure without avoidance.

rows.title: Recover the original RFSA round
rows.assessment: First-round notice exists; operative RFSA, amendments and authenticated Q&A remain missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Apply the first-round RFSA and amendments, not later Round 2 wording. The 23 July launch identified a first-round 14 August deadline. [S05, S06]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Issued RFSA W8703-270055, original qualification matrix, questions/answers, closing rules and version history.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A seemingly missing criterion was never required in the relevant round, or a later requirement did not apply retrospectively.

rows.title: Confirm the qualified legal entity
rows.assessment: Award parent and subsidiary distinctions documented; executed SA/bid identity crosswalk absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Compare SA holder, bidder and contractor, including any permitted affiliate or joint venture. Draganfly Inc. and Draganfly Innovations Inc. must not be treated as interchangeable. [S01, S40]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Executed SA, entity registration, bid signature, affiliate resource undertaking, assignment/novation consent where relevant.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The same qualified contractor performs using disclosed, permitted affiliates; group-level publicity merely shortens the name.

rows.title: Resolve qualification dates and conditions
rows.assessment: August 24/28 public dates preserved with ordinary date explanations; actual effective decision missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Establish when qualification became effective and the stage at which it was required; reconcile the 24 August record with the issuer's 28 August description. [S06]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Qualification decision, signed SA, acceptance/notification timestamps, conditional approvals and portal activation.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Issue, acceptance and public announcement occurred on different dates, all before the relevant eligibility deadline.

rows.title: Confirm the correct stream and product scope
rows.assessment: Notice says Stream 1; issuer says five streams; actual permitted product/stream schedule absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Qualification in one DDI stream or for one capability does not automatically authorize every downstream competition.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: SA schedules, qualified capability/product list, stream definition, category restrictions and authorized users/order ceiling.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Stream 1 qualification expressly covered Astiia or permitted a later specific product proposal; there was no requirement to qualify a named model initially.

rows.title: Retest each qualification gate
rows.assessment: Candidate Q&A and Australian partner history narrow hypotheses; authenticity and bidder own-role evidence absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Identify required experience, technical maturity, manufacturing capacity, Canadian business substance and certifications, and when they had to exist.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Submitted qualification evidence, criterion-by-criterion evaluation, reference checks, demonstrations and verification notes.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Allied partner experience or licensed production was permitted; previous CAF contracting or wholly Canadian intellectual property was not mandatory. [S05]

rows.title: Examine cures and admissions consistently
rows.assessment: No controlling cure/refresh provisions or applicant correction records.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Determine whether deficiencies could be corrected, additional evidence submitted or applicants admitted between refresh windows, and whether comparable applicants received the same opportunity.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: RFSA cure/refresh provisions, clarification correspondence, failed/pending applications and decision dates.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The RFSA allowed the correction or rolling admission and officials applied the same rule consistently.

rows.title: Reconstruct the eligible invitation pool
rows.assessment: No actual ordering/invitation rule, dated eligible roster or distribution logs.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Test the SA's actual invitation rule: all suppliers, minimum number, rotation, capability subset or another method. Do not invent an all-holders rule.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Dated roster, suspension/reinstatement record, invitation list, selection rationale and distribution logs.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: An expressly permitted capability-based subset received the RFP, while other holders were outside scope or not yet qualified.

rows.title: Check access and continuing eligibility
rows.assessment: Public retrieval failures are not bidder access evidence; actual permissions and eligibility history absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Establish whether eligible suppliers could obtain the operative package and whether any suspension, expiry or certification change affected Draganfly before award.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Ariba permissions, invitation delivery/bounce logs, access requests, help-desk tickets, SA validity and change notices.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Access problems were corrected in time or arose outside the buyer's control; eligibility remained valid under the SA's continuing-obligation clauses.

rows.title: Explain RFP A and RFP B
rows.assessment: A/B notice references identified; exact configurations and winning-package mapping absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Determine whether A and B concern separate configurations, lots, phases or award paths, and which produced CW2467949. [S02]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Both complete packages, cross-reference notices, number-of-awards provisions, evaluation plans and award mapping.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Distinct competitions legitimately shared a parent number. A requirement from one did not govern the other.

rows.title: Resolve the aircraft and ground vehicle mismatch
rows.assessment: Original public notice mismatch verified; no authenticated bidder-package mismatch or effect.
rows.original_test: P1 | Fact and contract: Trace the UAS title/UGV body inconsistency into the materials bidders actually saw. Test whether it impaired access, understanding or competition. [S02]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Original portal package, edit log, translations, bidder questions, correction notices and technical statement of requirement.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A public-page template error was corrected or never appeared in the authoritative aircraft solicitation; no bidder was misled.

rows.title: Test the response period under applicable rules
rows.assessment: CFTA reasonable-period rule checked; applicability, actual access times and SA-specific timetable unresolved.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract and any covered treaty: Assess the 27 August to 3 September period against this SA, the requirements' complexity and any applicable permitted reductions. Do not import unrelated service-SA rules. [S02, S12-S15]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Exact issue/access time, tender timetable, urgency rationale, extension requests and responses.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Prequalified bidders had adequate preparation and the permitted downstream process did not require a longer period.

rows.title: Authenticate every amendment
rows.assessment: Secondary September 1/3 and UAS/UGV differences found; governing versions/redlines not acquired.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Establish what changed, when, who approved it, who received it and whether time to respond was extended as required.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: All addenda and Q&A, redlines, distribution timestamps, acknowledgement rules and closing extensions.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The 3 September metadata reflects a minor public-notice edit rather than a material RFP amendment. Third-party amendment counts may combine different events. [S02]

rows.title: Check equal answers and private briefings
rows.assessment: Common public engagement opportunities documented; actual Q&A and private briefing contents absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract and fairness: Compare questions, answers, demonstrations and one-to-one briefings for materially unequal information.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Q&A register including unanswered questions, meeting notes, help-desk communications and common clarification releases.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Private exchanges concerned administrative access or genuinely proprietary details; all generally material information was distributed to eligible bidders.

rows.title: Trace restrictive specifications to the need
rows.assessment: No final specification, equivalency language or restrictive-need rationale.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract and any covered treaty: Identify brand, dimensions, interfaces, origin restrictions, experience thresholds or delivery dates that unnecessarily excluded alternatives. [S12-S15]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Needs analysis, market research, drafting history, equivalency language, technical rationale and supplier input.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A restriction was objectively needed for interoperability, safety, security or urgency and was clearly disclosed and consistently evaluated.

rows.title: Identify supplier involvement in drafting
rows.assessment: Industry engagement predates award; no source proves self-serving drafting or unmitigated information advantage.
rows.original_test: P2 | Policy and contract: Prior market engagement is not itself improper. Test whether a participant shaped specifications for itself or retained non-public information without effective mitigation. [S18, S26]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Requests for information, demonstration invitations, consultant terms, specification metadata, contact logs and conflict mitigation.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Officials independently validated the requirements and shared material information; the supplier's ordinary expertise created no unfair advantage.

rows.title: Check complete evaluation instructions
rows.assessment: No final mandatory/rated/price/quantity allocation method.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Locate every mandatory gate, rated criterion, pass mark, weight, price formula, option quantity, tie-breaker, allocation rule and right to make multiple awards.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Final instructions, evaluation matrix and locked evaluation plan approved before closing.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The apparent discretionary award was expressly permitted by the published selection method; the winner was not required to have the lowest bare unit price.

rows.title: Check bid submission mechanics
rows.assessment: No received-bid channel/time/signature/acknowledgement register.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Apply the stipulated channel, deadline/time zone, signature, format, file-size, language and acknowledgement rules; distinguish mandatory requirements from conveniences.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Bid receipt/opening register, original files and hashes, server logs, outage notices, late/replacement bid handling and amendment acknowledgements.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A permitted correction, verified platform outage procedure or non-mandatory formatting defect explains acceptance without unequal treatment.

rows.title: Check cancellation and negotiation reservations
rows.assessment: No governing cancellation/negotiation reservations or use record.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Determine whether government reserved a lawful right to cancel, negotiate, seek best-and-final offers, waive specified defects or change quantities; test its use against the actual terms.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Reservation clauses, approval/rationale, negotiation invitations and any relaunched solicitation.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The process used a disclosed mechanism consistently and did not secretly replace an essential competed requirement.

rows.title: Preserve the original bids
rows.assessment: No original Draganfly bid or later clarification inventory.
rows.original_test: P1 | Evidence and contract: Work from the bid as received before closing, separately identifying every later clarification or replacement page.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Read-only originals, attachment inventory, submission timestamps, audit trail and evaluators' working copies.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A document thought to be a late improvement was already in the timely bid; later correspondence merely identified its location.

rows.title: Reperform mandatory compliance
rows.assessment: No controlling mandatory matrix, deadlines or original compliant evidence.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: For each mandatory criterion, record the exact promised capability, evidence, compliance deadline and evaluator conclusion. Do not treat delivery-stage requirements as necessarily due at bid closing.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Compliance matrix, original technical offer, verification material and rejection reasons.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The bidder met the criterion in the prescribed way or valid equivalency applied; a preferred feature was not mandatory.

rows.title: Distinguish clarification from bid repair
rows.assessment: No bid-to-clarification comparison or authorized cure rule.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Identify whether later exchanges explained an existing commitment or supplied a new commitment necessary to become responsive; check any phased-compliance process.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Every clarification, request, response, revised page and governing cure clause; comparison with other bidders' defects.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The solicitation expressly allowed the cure, or the response clarified timely evidence without changing the offer.

rows.title: Reproduce rated scores
rows.assessment: No individual/consensus score sheets or locked formulas.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Recalculate each weighted score and pass mark; trace material differences between individual and consensus ratings. [S19]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Individual worksheets, reasons, consensus notes, spreadsheet formulas/version history and peer review.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A reasoned consensus corrected an individual misunderstanding under the published rubric; a high-level summary omitted that explanation.

rows.title: Test demonstrations and samples fairly
rows.assessment: Public demonstrations are not comparative procurement tests; actual protocols/raw results absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Compare configuration, payload, weather, route, operator skill, test opportunities, failures, retests and any waivers across bidders.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Predetermined protocol, raw measurements, video if retained, calibration records, evaluator notes and exception approvals.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Different conditions were normalized under the protocol or an authorized retest was offered consistently. A polished demonstration alone does not prove production compliance.

rows.title: Look for undisclosed criteria
rows.assessment: No final selection method paired with score/decision rationale.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Identify factors used in ranking that were absent from the published method, including political desirability, relationships, extra features or an unannounced production preference.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Score rationales, decision brief, meeting records and communications compared with the final evaluation matrix.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The factor was genuinely within a disclosed criterion and supported by documented evidence rather than a new criterion introduced after bids arrived.

rows.title: Check evaluator independence and information separation
rows.assessment: No evaluator identities, conflict declarations, recusals or price-access records.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy: Test conflict declarations, recusals and price-access controls against the applicable PSPC-led evaluation rules. [S19, S26]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Team composition, signed declarations, access permissions, timestamps for technical completion and financial opening, substitute-evaluator records.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Necessary access was segregated, a conflict was effectively mitigated or the approved process differed for a justified reason.

rows.title: Recalculate evaluated price
rows.assessment: No signed price schedule or evaluated-price model.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Rebuild the financial comparison using the announced quantities, options, support costs, tax treatment, currency conversion, discounts, rounding and arithmetic correction rules.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Original price schedules, locked model, exchange-rate source/date, formula audit and independent recalculation.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A higher initial package price wins under a correctly disclosed total-cost or value-weighted formula.

rows.title: Test multiple awards and allocations
rows.assessment: Multiple public awards exist; actual allocation rules/ranking not acquired.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Establish how award count, quantity allocation, technical categories, ties and reserve suppliers were determined.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Published allocation method, comparative ranking, award recommendation and records for other relevant lots without conflating their prices.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Draganfly's allocation followed a disclosed portfolio or capacity-based method, rather than winner-take-all lowest price.

rows.title: Compare negotiated and evaluated offers
rows.assessment: No evaluated-offer to signed-contract redline or negotiation approvals.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Track changes to price, product, quantities, delivery, liability and conditions after selection. Determine whether they were allowed and materially changed the competition.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Negotiation record, bid-to-contract redline, approval of deviations and best-and-final requests where used.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Clarifications or permitted negotiations preserved the essential basis of competition and required approvals.

rows.title: Audit the signed recommendation and debriefs
rows.assessment: No signed recommendation, approval chain or actual bidder debriefs.
rows.original_test: P2 | Policy and contract: Match final scores, technical endorsement, financial review, approval and award notification. Reconcile regret/debrief explanations with the actual evaluation. [S18, S19]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Signed consensus/recommendation, dissent or review findings, approval chain and unsuccessful-bidder correspondence.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A debrief was abbreviated or protected competitor information, while the underlying record supports the same result.

rows.title: Explain the published value
rows.assessment: Notice amount and tax dictionary checked; contract/reporting worksheet mapping absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Fact and reporting: Reconcile C$439,851.55 to signed line items and the public field definitions. Establish taxes, currency, initial versus amended value and whether options are excluded. [S01, S20]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Basis of payment, maximum liability, posting worksheet and amendments.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The public amount is the authorized firm package while unit rates or future options remain confidential or uncommitted.

rows.title: Authenticate the optional quantity and value
rows.assessment: Original issuer option claim checked; executed quantities/windows/prices absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Verify the issuer's 4,900 additional systems and approximate C$24.25 million against the executed option language. [S03]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Quantity bands, option windows, price schedule, training/support options, escalation and tax basis.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The announcement accurately describes contingent capacity, not a government obligation or booked revenue; rounded publicity differs from precise contractual arithmetic.

rows.title: Check the approval value includes what it must
rows.assessment: Official 2026 directive valuation and separate acquisition-instrument gate read; actual estimate/options treatment and approval missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy: Determine how each relevant authority values taxes, options, amendments and contingent liabilities; do not use the firm order automatically. [S17, S18]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Approval worksheet, original estimate, exception/delegation and amendment forecasts.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Required options were included in approval even though they were omitted from initial public reporting or annual commitment accounting.

rows.title: Verify mandatory price support consultation
rows.assessment: Pre-award PSPC price-support triggers include options/taxes; estimate, actual consultation and exception absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy: If PSPC's current rule applies, check consultation for competitive procurements of C$10m or more including taxes/options/amendments; C$7.5m or more with one compliant offer including taxes/options; and C$7.5m or more including taxes where prices are negotiated or likely to be negotiated by amendment. [S18]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Applicable directive/version, estimate, referral, advice and documented pricing decision, or authorized exception.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Consultation occurred or a genuine exception applied. The public C$0.44m entry is not automatically the relevant denominator.

rows.title: Examine price reasonableness and assumptions
rows.assessment: No required price-validation/cost/comparable-package analysis.
rows.original_test: P2 | Policy and contract: Test the price analysis actually required, including supplier quotes, learning curves, exchange rates, profit assumptions and comparable package contents.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Price validation, comparable buys, cost substantiation where required, negotiation brief and sensitivity analysis.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Differences reflect payload, support, warranty, volume, delivery urgency or currency rather than excessive margins. A weak value-for-money case alone does not prove illegality.

rows.title: Test volume pricing and escalation
rows.assessment: No option bands, escalation, FX or negotiation schedule.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Check whether option prices decrease, increase, remain fixed or require negotiation, and whether the evaluated model captured the permitted pattern.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Quantity-band schedule, indexation formula, FX base date, economic-price-adjustment clauses, renewal rates and amendment rules.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: An apparent price increase follows an authorized index or a different configuration; nominal unit comparisons omit included services.

rows.title: Check payment structure and advances
rows.assessment: No advance/progress payment terms, security or liquidation evidence.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law and contract: Distinguish advance payments, progress payments, accepted deliveries and reimbursable costs; test applicable authority, security and reconciliation requirements. [S07]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Payment milestones, security/guarantee if required, invoices, holdbacks, liquidation of advances and audit rights.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: An authorized advance bought tooling or long-lead parts with adequate protection; payment before final delivery was expressly permitted.

rows.title: Check hidden recurring and lifecycle costs
rows.assessment: No full lifecycle-cost model and recurring support/licence schedule.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Identify subscriptions, data plans, software seats, licence renewals, batteries, spare parts, repair, training and disposal costs outside the headline price.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Complete lifecycle-cost model, software/support agreements, option schedules and end-of-term obligations.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Ongoing costs were disclosed and evaluated or knowingly budgeted as separate requirements; a low acquisition price was not represented as the whole lifecycle cost.

rows.title: Check client concurrence and required reviews
rows.assessment: No client concurrence or mandatory review/deviation file.
rows.original_test: P2 | Policy: Verify DND's written acceptance of specifications/evaluation criteria and required legal, security, risk or other reviews. [S18]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Client sign-off, review checklist, comments, resolutions and approvals for deviations.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A review was not mandatory for this risk category, or the required concurrence exists outside the central procurement file.

rows.title: Audit reduced Crown protections
rows.assessment: 2026 Appendix B.2.5 provides a DIA approval route for specified risk departures; actual clauses and approval absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Policy and contract: Examine unusual liability caps, shortened warranties, disclaimers, indemnities, termination payments and reduced audit rights. Apply required legal review before treating a departure as unauthorized. [S18]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Standard-to-final redline, legal review, client acceptance, insurance requirements and approval record.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A negotiated allocation of risk was expressly approved and reflected in price; it was not an unexplained waiver.

rows.title: Verify integrity screening
rows.assessment: Primary policy and public company lists checked; no Draganfly listing, but award-date screening/declarations absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy and contract: Apply the incorporated Ineligibility and Suspension Policy version and its actual grounds, exceptions and procedures. An allegation or investor association is not disqualification. [S25]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Declarations, required names, pre-award checks, relevant final decisions and any administrative agreement or public-interest exception.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: No applicable ground existed, the actor was outside the rule's scope, or a valid exception covered the award.

rows.title: Check subcontractor integrity obligations
rows.assessment: Primary first-tier policy scope clarified; actual subcontractors and verification records absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Determine which first-tier subcontractors required screening or approval and whether the contractor satisfied the clause. [S25]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Actual subcontractor list, screening dates, declarations, substitution notices and approval records.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A vendor was outside the clause's defined subcontractor scope or properly screened. Do not treat every ordinary supplier as a prohibited subcontractor.

rows.title: Investigate concrete conflicts of interest
rows.assessment: Senate/lobbying facts and current directive conflict duty checked; actual award participation/mitigation file absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy: Look for decision-maker financial interests, family/business relationships, gifts, employment negotiations and privileged access that required disclosure or mitigation. [S26]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Declarations, recusals, meeting/contact logs and decision participation, using relevant corroborated facts.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The relationship was disclosed and effectively managed, or the person had no role in the decision. Mere acquaintance is not proof of favouritism.

rows.title: Audit lobbying registration and reports
rows.assessment: Known consultant roles and 44 report rows checked; not all communications or a meeting count.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law: Identify the actual paid consultant or in-house role, activity, officials contacted, subject and applicable registration/reporting rule at the time. [S27]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Registry histories, mandates, communication dates and official meeting records; distinguish a 2025 registration from a 2026 communication.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The contact was registered, reportable only under a different rule, exempt or outside lobbying activity. A registry entry alone is not evidence of improper influence.

rows.title: Check former official restrictions precisely
rows.assessment: 2009 retirement and 2025 undertaking weaken waiting-period theory; later office and all contract restrictions not fully established.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law and contract: Establish former role, departure date, designated-office-holder status, actual lobbying activity and applicable cooling-off/exemption rules. Treat pension-related procurement clauses separately. [S27, S28]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Employment dates, duties, exemptions, relevant advisory mandate and the actual clause.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The period expired, an exemption applied, no prohibited lobbying occurred or a corporate employee was outside a personal-services disclosure clause.

rows.title: Test representations against contemporaneous evidence
rows.assessment: No signed eligibility/origin/security/capacity attestations with contemporaneous substantiation.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Identify material statements about eligibility, capacity, origin, security or product readiness and whether they were accurate when certified.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Signed attestations, substantiating records then available, verification questions, later corrections and continuing-notification duties.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A statement was a clearly permitted future commitment rather than a present fact, or a material change was disclosed and approved. Later difficulty alone does not prove an earlier lie.

rows.title: Examine post award investment triggers
rows.assessment: Financing closing corroborated; voting/control/access rights and notification triggers unacquired.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract and conditional law: The 28 September issuer release describes a planned US$10m offering, not independently verified closing or control. Test actual voting, board, veto, information and technology-access rights. [S41]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Closing documents, cap table, agreements and relevant change-notification clauses.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Minority investment caused no regulated control/access change, or required notices and mitigation were completed. Shareholder nationality alone does not establish non-compliance.

rows.title: Check assignment and unauthorized substitution
rows.assessment: Public corporate announcements do not prove CAF contract transfer; assignment clause and consent absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Distinguish a share investment, subcontract, asset transfer, licence change and legal assignment of the Crown contract.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Corporate transaction documents, actual performing entity, novation/assignment clause, consent and payment-registration changes.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The contractor remained unchanged and used permitted affiliates; no assignment consent was required. Separate Investment Canada Act questions require their own factual trigger.

rows.title: Establish the applicable Canadian preference
rows.assessment: Strategic policy scope/threshold/definitions read; award estimate, transition and exception application unresolved.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy and contract: Determine whether the strategic Buy Canadian policy applied, including its C$5m threshold for qualifying procurements published after 15 June 2026, SA transition rules and exceptions. [S23]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Estimated value including relevant options, RFSA/RFP dates, policy clause, scoring method and exception approval.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A valid transition/exception applies, or the policy required evaluation credits rather than an absolute Canadian-only gate.

rows.title: Apply the actual Canadian supplier definition
rows.assessment: Canadian incorporation/subsidiary activity counterevidence acquired; actual eligibility attestation absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Test required permanent business, registration/tax and substantive Canadian activity. Do not replace the actual definition with a wholly Canadian shareholder test. [S23]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Entity records, facilities, employees, business operations and signed eligibility attestation at the required date.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The bidder meets the definition despite foreign investors, a foreign office or exchange listing.

rows.title: Recalculate Canadian content and value added
rows.assessment: No contractual Canadian-value method, bill of materials or certified line-item calculation.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Use the solicitation's definition, denominator, credits and permitted imported components. Do not invent an 80 percent threshold or use consumer labelling tests. [S23]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Line-item origin declarations, bill of materials, invoices, Canadian labour/development costs and methodology.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Licensed allied technology and imported parts were allowed and correctly accounted for; Canadian value added meets the actual requirement.

rows.title: Verify where work actually occurs
rows.assessment: Official licensed-production plan exists; actual work allocation and milestone performance absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Compare promised Canadian manufacture, assembly, integration, training, support and sustainment with the delivered work allocation. [S04, S05]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Production plan, facility and subcontract records, work orders, staffing, test/assembly logs and shipment origins.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The tender allowed staged localization or imported subassemblies, with the required Canadian activities performed by the contractual milestone.

rows.title: Authenticate the Astiia licence
rows.assessment: Developer/official licensing statements acquired; executed licence and licensor chain of authority absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Verify enforceable rights for the particular model, term, territory, quantities and uses. Officially announced licensed production is neither proof of a signed licence nor a violation of sovereignty policy. [S04, S05, S35]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Executed licence and amendments, licensor authority, sublicensing, manufacture, modification, repair, software-update and training rights.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Valid rights cover the Canadian programme and its options, with required consents.

rows.title: Test licence continuity and Crown access
rows.assessment: No contractual Crown rights, step-in, escrow, termination/insolvency or support continuity schedules.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Examine termination, insolvency, change-of-control, export restriction and support-cessation risks; identify rights promised to Canada after supplier/licensor failure. [S35]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Background/foreground IP schedules, technical-data licence, escrow if required, step-in/sustainment rights and termination provisions.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Appropriate government use, repair and continuity rights exist even though the Crown does not own every patent or source file.

rows.title: Verify software and third party IP rights
rows.assessment: No firmware/software licence inventory or third-party consents.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Check firmware, ground-control software, mapping, codecs and open-source components for permitted government deployment, copying, modification and distribution.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Software bill of materials, licence inventory, third-party consents, deliverables and restriction notices.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Proper licences support the required use; proprietary components are allowed and do not conflict with promised Crown rights. Public branding is not an IP chain of title.

rows.title: Test financial capability against actual obligations
rows.assessment: Original issuer finances/fundraising checked; required contract-specific capability assessment/mitigations absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Policy and contract: Distinguish preliminary SA viability from ability to perform the defined firm order and option lead times. Losses or financing dependence alone do not make a bid non-responsive. [S42]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Required financial assessment, committed credit/guarantees, cash-flow plan, insurance and risk mitigation.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Financing and mitigations support the contracted schedule, notwithstanding weak historical revenue or continuing fundraising.

rows.title: Verify the production ramp and critical dependencies
rows.assessment: No firm-order production plan, tooling/component commitments or capacity/lead-time acceptance record.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Test staffing, tooling, yields, component supply, quality assurance and repair capacity against due quantities, not an assumed immediate 5,000-unit order.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Milestone plan, purchase orders, capacity reservations, alternate suppliers, long-lead inventory and tested production output.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The initial order fits existing capacity; later quantities require lead time and written option exercise before expansion is due.

rows.title: Establish actual contract security requirements
rows.assessment: Primary security manual selected provisions read; actual SRCL and incorporated security scope missing.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Obtain the security requirements checklist and incorporated clauses. Distinguish protected information, classified access, safeguarding, IT and personnel requirements. [S29]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: SRCL, security guide, required entity/site/personnel clearances and the dates each became necessary.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: No protected/classified access was required for a particular activity, or appropriate clearance existed before the relevant access or performance milestone.

rows.title: Reconstruct the FOCI decision
rows.assessment: Official prospective FOCI statement and actual timing rules checked; no completed decision/entity/scope/date.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract and policy: Reconcile foreign ownership, control or influence review, mitigation and approval with signature, conditional award and release to work. The PM backgrounder is not a completed approval. [S04, S29]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Initiation/completion dates, approving authority, covered entity/sites, conditions and authorization to proceed.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Assessment was completed in time. Clearance after award resolves the concern only if the governing requirement permitted that timing; it cannot cure an express pre-award FOCI gate. Prospective announcement language may have been general.

rows.title: Check personnel and subcontract security
rows.assessment: No actual sensitive flows, approved subcontracts, personnel/site/foreign-transfer authorizations.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Apply screening, need-to-know, visitor, remote-access and subcontract-approval rules to the actual information flows, including foreign partners. [S29, S30]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Relevant authorizations, subcontract security clauses, site access, approved foreign-security arrangements and changes.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Access was appropriately limited or approved; an ordinary non-sensitive component purchase did not need classified-contract treatment.

rows.title: Classify controlled goods before alleging nonregistration
rows.assessment: Controlled-goods applicability requires actual configuration/data classification; military label is insufficient.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law: Determine whether actual hardware, firmware or technical data is controlled and which entity examines, possesses or transfers it. CGP is distinct from export permits and Secret clearance. [S31]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Classification, registrations/exemptions, covered sites, personnel assessments, designated official and transfer/access logs.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Items are not controlled, an exemption applies, or the relevant actor is properly registered. Military marketing alone is not classification.

rows.title: Verify the correct CGP entity and dates
rows.assessment: Earlier official subsidiary directory lead retained; parent/site/historical certificate scope unverified.
rows.original_test: P2 | Fact and law: The current directory lists Draganfly Innovations Inc. with expiry 21 September 2028; it does not establish the parent's coverage or award-date validity. Directory absence is also inconclusive. [S31]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Actual certificate, historical effective dates, legal-entity/site scope and applicable affiliate arrangements.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The subsidiary is the registered actor carrying out controlled work under a lawful structure; no parent registration was required for unregulated activity.

rows.title: Test cybersecurity certification only if required
rows.assessment: CPCSC selected-contract rule known; incorporation, network/entity scope and attestation date absent.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: CPCSC Level 1 began in selected defence contracts in summer 2026; initial guidance requires it at award rather than throughout bidding. Do not retroactively demand Level 2 or 3. [S24]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Incorporated requirement, assessment/attestation date, entity/network scope, annual renewal and subcontract obligations.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: This contract did not invoke CPCSC, or the appropriate certification was in place at the required stage.

rows.title: Map mission data and external access
rows.assessment: No delivered data-flow, hosting/access architecture or applicable security boundary.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract and security: Trace video, coordinates, metadata, logs, crash reports, support sessions and backups; compare storage, transit, access and retention with the actual clauses. [S29, S43]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Data-flow diagram, approved cloud/endpoints, access controls, ownership/use clauses and test evidence.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Architecture meets approved boundaries. Foreign ownership alone does not prove data leaves Canada, and Canadian hosting alone does not prove all access risks are resolved.

rows.title: Test firmware and supply chain trust
rows.assessment: No configuration-specific provenance, update/disable/assurance evidence; no automatic US certification requirement.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract or engineering test: Examine provenance, signed updates, key custody, vulnerabilities, patch timelines, remote disable functions, credential defaults and component substitutions.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Configuration-specific software/hardware inventories, penetration or assurance reports, update process and incident obligations.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Risks meet accepted requirements and mitigations. U.S. NDAA, Blue UAS or Green UAS claims matter only for the exact model and any incorporated requirement.

rows.title: Verify import export and technology transfer permissions
rows.assessment: No actual hardware/data export classification or cross-border transfer; domestic CAF sale is not automatically export.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law and contract: Classify the actual goods/data, origins, destinations, end use and re-exports. Domestic sale to CAF is not automatically an export. [S36]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Canadian/Australian and any applicable U.S. classifications, licences/permits, exemptions, end-user conditions and foreign-access approvals.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Valid permissions cover the transfer or the item is outside the control. CGP registration does not substitute for foreign export authorization.

rows.title: Screen sanctions against the transaction
rows.assessment: Integrity policy sanctions nexus read; relevant transaction/ownership identities and applicable prohibitions unestablished.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law: Check relevant entities, ownership/control, banks, intermediaries and actual prohibitions at the transaction date; a list-name match alone is insufficient. [S37]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Due-diligence results, verified identities, ownership records, applicable regulation and any permit/exemption.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A namesake, no prohibited nexus, or valid authorization resolves the concern. No sanctions exposure is established by this checklist.

rows.title: Trace forced labour and reporting duties separately
rows.assessment: Original 2024 report catalogue corroborated; document fetch failed, current-year duty/filing and component evidence unverified.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law and contract: Test incorporated anti-forced-labour obligations and customs restrictions against specific components. Separately establish the supplier's Supply Chains Act reporting duty and filings. [S38, S39]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Supply-chain mapping, due diligence, credible component-specific evidence and dated annual reports/board approval if required.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Supplier evidence addresses the risk or a filing exists outside the search results. A missing report would not itself prove tainted drones or void the award.

rows.title: Freeze the delivered configuration
rows.assessment: No accepted Astiia model/hardware/firmware/payload/radio configuration baseline.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Establish exact Astiia model, hardware/firmware revision, payload, radios, batteries and accessories; compare bid, test sample, approved design and production units.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Approved configuration baseline, serial numbers, change notices, substitutions and acceptance records.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: An equivalent or improved component was approved under change control. Experience with an Australian version does not alone establish Canadian configuration compliance. [S04]

rows.title: Apply the correct airworthiness route
rows.assessment: Military/civil operating authority, category and clearance route require actual operator/mission records.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law and DND policy: Determine civil versus military operation and the applicable category. CAR 102.01 excludes Canadian military aircraft manoeuvred under MND authority; contractor demonstrations cannot automatically borrow that status. [S32, S33]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Operating intent, weight/category, operator, authority, required technical/operational clearance or applicable Open Category/sub-micro route.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A lawful alternative or exemption applies; absence of a conventional certificate alone is not proof of unauthorized flight.

rows.title: Test mission performance in the required conditions
rows.assessment: No final mission thresholds, loaded configuration or independent acceptance measurements.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Check endurance, range, payload/EO-IR performance, image quality, latency, navigation and interoperability against the final annex, with the stated load and environment.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Raw test results, calibration, independent acceptance record, configuration and pass/fail thresholds.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The system met the specified mission profile even if a marketing maximum differs. No numerical or MIL-STD/ISO/STANAG requirement should be invented.

rows.title: Test reliability safety and environmental claims
rows.assessment: No specified environmental/safety limits and test/waiver/defect disposition.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract or engineering test: Examine cold, wind, precipitation/ingress, vibration, electromagnetic interference, GNSS-degraded/lost-link behaviour, failsafes and operator hazards where required.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Approved procedures, failure logs, risk acceptance, corrective actions and retests.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Limits are explicitly stated and accepted, or an authorized waiver/equivalence applies. A risk or failure during development is not necessarily a breach at acceptance.

rows.title: Verify spectrum authorization and certification
rows.assessment: Exact transmitter/frequency/configuration and applicable spectrum/certification authority absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law and configuration: Match transmitter, module, antenna, power, frequency, modification and operating location to applicable ISED certification, licence/exemption or military authority. FCC approval is not enough. [S34]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Radio Equipment List entry where applicable, certificates, spectrum authorization and as-delivered configuration.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The configuration is certified or a valid exemption/special authorization applies; licence-exempt does not automatically mean exempt from technical standards.

rows.title: Verify batteries transport and returns
rows.assessment: Battery design, mode, consignor and actual shipment needed before transport rules apply.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law and contract: Apply dangerous-goods rules to the battery design, Wh rating, shipping mode, packaging and responsible consignor; damaged returns need separate attention. [S44]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Relevant UN test summary, classification, shipping documents, labels, training and special permits/exemptions.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Shipment complied under a valid mode-specific exception. UN38.3 transport testing alone does not prove flight endurance or military acceptance.

rows.title: Check training manuals and usability deliverables
rows.assessment: Issuer initial/optional training descriptions checked; syllabus/manuals/delivery/acceptance absent.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Verify initial cadre training, optional additional training, instructor competence, manuals, safety instructions, language and accessibility requirements actually promised. [S03]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Training syllabus/attendance, delivered manual revisions, exercises, operator assessment and acceptance sign-off.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The firm contract required only initial training; later sessions depend on options. A preferred language or format was not necessarily a mandatory deliverable.

rows.title: Check sustainment warranty and obsolescence
rows.assessment: No actual sustainment, warranty, spares, update or obsolescence obligations/results.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Test spare quantities, repair turnaround, warranty start/exclusions, software support, consumables, tooling, end-of-life notices and post-term data/parts access.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Support plan, service-level terms, spares inventory, warranty claims and licence continuity commitments.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Support meets the agreed service level or an accepted repair corrected a defect; an out-of-warranty failure does not prove original non-compliance.

rows.title: Establish what was actually due and delivered
rows.assessment: No firm delivery schedule and serial-numbered receipts; silence does not prove lateness.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Compare contractual dates, locations, quantities and configurations with delivery receipts; distinguish shipment, receipt, inspection and acceptance.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Delivery schedule, packing lists, serial-number register, receiving reports and approved extensions.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The deadline has not arrived, an authorized extension applies or a shipment awaits agreed acceptance testing. No public delivery announcement is not proof of failure.

rows.title: Audit acceptance and rejected units
rows.assessment: No authorized acceptance, rejection, retest or concession records.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Verify authorized acceptance against required tests, including partial/conditional acceptance, rejected units, rework and concession approvals.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Inspection/acceptance certificates, non-conformance reports, retests, defect classification and authorized waivers.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Defects were corrected before acceptance or a permitted concession was documented; raw failure logs without disposition are incomplete evidence.

rows.title: Match payments to permitted milestones
rows.assessment: No invoice/receipt/contract match or FAA certification/payment evidence.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law and contract: Reconcile invoices, accepted quantities, advance/progress provisions, credits, taxes and FAA certification. [S07]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Three-way contract/receipt/invoice match, authorized section 34 certification, payment record and duplicate-invoice controls.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A payment relates to a lawful milestone, training or tooling rather than an undelivered aircraft. Price and cash paid need not equal on the same date.

rows.title: Verify every option exercise
rows.assessment: No actual written option exercise; option publicity is not an order.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract: Check written authorization, authorized signatory, issue within the option window, quantity/configuration, original pricing formula, delivery lead time and available funding.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Option notice, amendment, requisition, commitment and updated maximum liability.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: No option has yet been exercised, or a valid exercise complied with all terms. Optional capacity is not itself an order.

rows.title: Test amendments against competed scope
rows.assessment: No operative scope/options paired with actual amendment/approval record.
rows.original_test: P1 | Contract and applicable procurement rules: Determine whether later changes are a permitted option, administrative correction or material new requirement needing additional authority or competition.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Original scope/options, amendment redline, aggregate value, rationale, approval and new price analysis.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The change was anticipated, priced and competed, or a separately justified lawful exception covers the new work.

rows.title: Check continuing obligations and incidents
rows.assessment: No actual notification clauses/register and triggering events tied to their deadlines.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract: Test required notifications for ownership, sites, key subcontractors, security incidents, defects, financial distress, licence changes and production relocation.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Notification register, incident reports, change approvals, mitigation, revised certifications and corrective-action closure.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: The triggering event did not occur, did not fall within the clause or was notified and resolved within the required period.

rows.title: Follow inventory remedies and closeout
rows.assessment: No delivered inventory/custody/returns/credits/closeout record; due stages unverified.
rows.original_test: P2 | Contract and financial control: Reconcile delivered assets with inventory, custody, losses, returns, warranty credits, termination settlements and final release obligations.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Asset register, loss/return records, remedies considered, credits, final account and data/property return or destruction certificates when due.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Properly documented training consumption, authorized transfer or replacement explains a count difference; lawful discretion explains not pursuing a disproportionate remedy.

rows.title: Separate the disclosure regimes and deadlines
rows.assessment: Ordinary October 30 quarterly deadline not passed; complete publication regime/fields/version history unresolved.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law and policy: Distinguish CanadaBuys history, any treaty award notice and quarterly proactive publication. A September contract's ordinary ATIA section 86 quarter deadline is 30 October 2026; it is not late on 13 October. [S20-S22]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Applicable regime, required fields, publication dates, exemptions and correction history.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Publication is timely under the correct regime. A missing search result is not proof of an unpublished record.

rows.title: Test confidentiality field by field
rows.assessment: ATIA framework identified; no actual withholding decision, field-by-field exemption or severability assessment.
rows.original_test: P1 | Law: A commercial confidentiality clause does not alone decide ATIA withholding. Identify the actual statutory basis and seek severable non-sensitive information; section 90 addresses proactive publication exceptions. [S21]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Decision record, withheld-field explanation, exemption relied on and severability assessment.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Unit rates or security details are properly withheld while the aggregate award remains public. “Commercially sensitive” may refer to narrower information than every financial term.

rows.title: Reconcile public statements and later corrections
rows.assessment: Issuer/government statements separated from performance; no executed contract to settle every representation.
rows.original_test: P2 | Fact check: Compare department, ministerial and issuer statements with contract terms, signed orders, actual delivery and accounting periods; label claims by source.
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Dated releases/filings, government approvals, correction correspondence and underlying values.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: One statement describes optional potential and another firm spending; different scopes or dates explain the difference. A communications error need not invalidate the procurement.

rows.title: Test record completeness and preservation
rows.assessment: 2026 directive specifies government record categories; no actual government file index/retention/disposition proof.
rows.original_test: P1 | Policy and evidence: Verify required decisions, individual/consensus evaluations, approvals, communications and financial validations were retained; identify the applicable retention schedule rather than inventing a universal period. [S18, S19, S45]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: File index, native spreadsheets/messages, audit trails, retention/disposition authority, transfer logs and recorded missing documents.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: Records reside with the technical team, security custodian or former organizational unit rather than in the central file; redaction does not prove destruction.

rows.title: Check complaints and oversight without presuming standing
rows.assessment: Bounded original oversight searches executed; inaccessible titles and generic reviews not award findings.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law: Search CITT, OPO, courts and relevant audit/committee records by supplier and procurement IDs. Distinguish allegations, decisions, settlements and final findings. [S11, S46, S47]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Complete pleadings/decisions, jurisdiction, disposition and response. Examine OPO practice reviews separately from individual award complaints.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: No complaint was filed, it concerned another procurement or it was rejected on jurisdiction rather than merits. Absence of a case is not proof of compliance.

rows.title: Reconstruct remedy deadlines separately
rows.original_priority: P1 when a bidder is considering action
rows.assessment: No supplier remedy action is being undertaken in this journalistic task; bidder-specific knowledge/standing/deadlines remain unresolved.
rows.original_test: P1 when a bidder is considering action | Law: CITT normally requires action within 10 working days of actual/constructive knowledge, with a timely-objection route and narrow exceptions; ATIP does not automatically stop the clock. A journalist is not automatically an eligible supplier complainant. [S11]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Trigger-by-ground ledger, objections/denials, debrief dates and completed filing date.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: A newly discovered fact has a different trigger; a public solicitation defect may have become time-barred much earlier.

rows.title: Check jurisdiction and legal versions before publishing a remedy claim
rows.assessment: Current NSE/jurisdiction changes and OPO thresholds examined; actual standing, coverage and challenged decision unestablished.
rows.original_test: P2 | Law: NSE, treaty scope and the 2025 Canadian-preference limits affect CITT jurisdiction. OPO award complaints normally concern below-CFTA-threshold contracts; court review and civil damages are different routes. [S11, S46, S47]
rows.decisive_record_requested_in_original: Current regulations, standing, challenged decision, forum and applicable limitation rule. Federal Courts Act judicial review ordinarily uses 30 days from communication, subject to extension.
rows.ordinary_explanation_to_test: One forum is unavailable without insulating every action from scrutiny; no universal damages deadline follows from the judicial-review period.
